notes.title: Major update 3.0.0 ADV mode has been implemented.
notes.notes:
ADV mode is implemented for those who do not need the story or RPG parts and just want to learn Go.

Fixed other minor bugs and added additional information.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634745/6a9072dc0d6673ff799ebe69cd2dc42e99cec866.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634745/7a85baac0d86b37d73155f04c836d3f9a6ea7ead.png"]

notes.title: Update 2.2.0: Standardized the turn for the problematic moves to Black.
notes.notes:
* Standardized the turn for all problems to Black
* Added variations to problems up to the point where stones are captured, as much as possible
* Added supplementary explanations for some parts

notes.title: Update 2.1.3 Added more explanations to the look back screen
notes.notes:
Added further explanation of the Reflection screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634745/c7a5f92cecdfab7cdf34fe207aa2b52f000641b2.png"]

notes.title: Update [2.1.1] Stone previews displayed when starting a move, etc.
notes.notes:
A preview of the current player's stone is now displayed when making a move. This makes it easier to see whose turn it is.

UI adjustments

Added move variations and supplementary explanations to problems
